title: Glycated hemoglobin levels in participants with diabetes and oral disease enrolled in the All of Us Research Program
html: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) increases the risk of developing periodontal disease, and severe periodontal disease leads to poor diabetic control based on blood levels of glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c). However, less is known about diabetic control and caries. The authors aimed to compare HbA1c levels in a cohort of All of Us Research Program study participants with T2DM who had received a diagnosis of caries, gingivitis, or periodontitis.
